messages:
ashley: Heads up — conversion of Llama2 tokenizer -> Mistral format during the int4 onboarding produced duplicated vocab entries for some combining-diacritic tokens. Seeing doubled embedding rows and a ~0.8-1.2 ROUGE-L drop on the summarization smoke suite :thinking_face:

ashley: Repro steps: saved tokenizer.json from llm2, ran our convert script, then quant run. Quick check shows duplicate tokens at the end of vocab file.

ashley: snippet to repro:```bash
python scripts/convert_tokenizer.py --in llm2/tokenizer.json --out mistral/tokenizer.json
# then: python -c "from collections import Counter; import json; v=json.load(open('mistral/tokenizer.json'))['tokens']; print([(t,c) for t,c in Counter(v).items() if c>1])"
```

devon: ugh. can you paste the duplicate list? might be NFKC vs NFC variants. also cc @mike for quant impact.

ashley: paste:```[('e01', 2), ('a27', 2), ('o08', 2)] # visually same but one is base+combining, other is precomposed
```

mike: yep that's classic. tokenizer conversion didn't normalize. int4 quantization is sensitive because duplicate entries mean embeddings array gets expanded and index-to-embedding mapping shifts in places. explains the small quality regression.

sana: quick mitigation: run unicode normalization to NFKC on tokens before deduping, then remap embedding matrix by keeping first occurrence. I can run the summarize-suite after.

ashley: trying that now. script I used:```python
import json, unicodedata, sys
T=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['tokens']
seen={}
out=[]
for i,t in enumerate(T):
  n=unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', t)
  if n not in seen:
    seen[n]=i
    out.append(n)
json.dump({'tokens':out}, open(sys.argv[2],'w'), ensure_ascii=False)
```

ashley: after dedupe+remap and re-quant (int4, same seed) model-bot: started eval job id eval-17955

model-bot: eval-17955 finished — summarization suite: ROUGE-L baseline 31.2 -> patched 31.9 (+0.7), latency diff +0.6ms, token cost unchanged.

mike: nice. that aligns with hypothesis. we should add a normalizer step in the conversion pipeline and a unit test that checks for duplicate normalized tokens.

devon: agreed. also add a guard in the embedding loader to assert len(vocab)==embeddings.shape[0] at load time and fail loudly. saved us later.

sana: will open PR with: 1) NFKC normalization + dedupe, 2) mapping logic to reorder embeddings, 3) unit test with synthetic tokens. I'll also run a quick quant sweep (int8/int4) across the small benchmark to ensure no perf cliff. ETA end of day.

ashley: thanks — filing a short postmortem note in the onboarding checklist and tagging the affected model family (llama2 variants). adding triage label to the conversion tool issue. :white_check_mark:

devon: one more thing — add an observability alert: if token count changes by >0.5% between conversion and final artefact, raise a warning so we catch accidental expansions.

mike: I'll add that to the console metrics team backlog.

ashley: done for now. re-run results copied into the model onboarding ticket.
